causal_basis.principle: isolate one measured or already-declared mechanism at a time; later stages cannot compensate for losing an earlier gate

common_behavior_contract.moving_gate: unchanged six-cell nominal gate: duration complete, bilateral transitions, candidate gate pass, zero action saturation, zero pitch-chain rate excess, and worst tracking p95 <= 0.20 rad
common_behavior_contract.zero_command_gate: duration complete, candidate gate pass, |mean local vx| <= 0.02 m/s, body pitch p95 <= 0.25 rad, base height >= 0.12 m, tracking p95 <= 0.20 rad, zero saturation, and zero rate excess
common_behavior_contract.checkpoint_persistence: both 512000 and 1024000 must pass every cell in every completed earlier stage

held_out_seed_derivation.method: split the source-result SHA256 into eight consecutive 32-bit big-endian words and reduce each modulo 2147483647
held_out_seed_derivation.note: the seed list was derived and frozen before any robustness outcome
